title: Pre-flight error title 'No filter wheel for SmartExposure' is untrue — a filter wheel is connected; the body says the real cause
what_happened: With the Simulated Filter Wheel connected and green on the Equipment screen, pre-flight blocked the run with an ERROR headed 'No filter wheel for SmartExposure'. The body reads correctly: 'requires a filter wheel, but the active equipment profile has no filters configured.' A user reads the heading, goes to Equipment, sees the wheel connected, and concludes the app is broken.
expected: Title should be 'No filters configured for SmartExposure'.
repro: Connect the sim filter wheel, do not add filters to the profile, add a Smart Exposure node, press Start.
verdict_reasoning: Verified at the named source. packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/sequence/rules/smart_exposure_rules.dart:174 sets `title: 'No filter wheel for SmartExposure'` while :176 sets the description to 'Smart Exposure "${node.name}" requires a filter wheel, but the active equipment profile has no filters configured.' The title asserts a hardware fact the app can and does contradict on the Equipment screen (I had the Simulated Filter Wheel connected and green throughout this session), while the body states the actual, different cause (an empty profile filter list). The consequence follows directly: a user reads the heading, checks Equipment, sees a connected wheel, and concludes the validator is broken. Not driven live for this one item — the rule text is unambiguous and there is no runtime behaviour to observe. P3 is correct: pure wording.
